description: Use-case check: parametric surrogate rho(tau; alpha, Gamma_down) of the driven two-level system (pure excited initial state), trained once by the L1 residual on a pool of parameter points (no data) and evaluated over the parameter range against the exact solution and the implicit L1 time stepper

train.pool_sampling: scrambled Sobol points in the parameter rectangle
train.grading: each parameter point has its own mesh tau_n = (n/N)^r, r = (2 - alpha)/alpha

network.inputs: tau and the two parameters scaled to [-1, 1]

test.grid: tensor grid of the parameter rectangle including its boundary (64 points, none of them in the training pool)
